senses.gloss: ch. sameto be wide, extend; to be easy; ר׳ ל־ to feel relieved.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 32:20">Targ. Job XXXII, 20</cite>.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 23:5">Targ. Ps. XXIII, 5</cite> <he>רויחא</he> Ms., ed. Lag. <he>רווחא</he>, v. <cite ref="T00366"><he>רְוִיתָא</he></cite>.]—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7a:5">Snh. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון דר׳ ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00158"><he>בִּדְקָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 8a:1">Ḥull. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>בית … מִירְוַוח ר׳</he> the cut widens, i.e. the parts cut through go apart, and are not affected by the heat of the knife.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 90b:6">B. Bath. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>תרעא דר׳ ר׳</he> when the market becomes easy (prices fall), it remains so (for the rest of the year).
<cite ref="Taanit 23b:10">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>אמינא … ר׳ עלמא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>דוו</he>, corr. acc.) I thought, as it has been raining, the world is at ease (prices will come down).
<cite ref="Ketubot 80b:4">Keth. 80ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00329"><he>רַוְוחָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 167a:5">B. Bath. 167ᵃ</cite> (suspecting an erasure in a document) <he>מ״ט רְוִיחַ ליה עלמא להאי וי״ו</he> why has this Vav so much space?, opp. <cite ref="D00405"><he>דחוק</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 20:5:2">Y. Sabb. XX, end, 17ᵈ</cite> <he>נפל ביתיה על מאן דרויח עליה</he> his house fell in over him who felt at ease (?), v. <cite ref="R00623"><he>צְנִינִים</he></cite>.—[
Targ. Is. XLIX, 20 רְוַח לי (prob. to be read: רַוַּח Pa.; h. text גְּשָׁה.]

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 18:16">Targ. Prov. XVIII, 16</cite> (h. text <he>ירחיב</he>).—Part. pass. <he>מְרַוַּוח</he>; f. <he>מְרַוְּוחָא</he>; pl. <he>מרַוְּוחִין</he>; <he>מְרַוְּוחָן</he>, <he>מְרַוְּח׳</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 22:14">Targ. Jer. XXII, 14</cite>.—

senses.gloss: to make profit, gain. Y. Ned. V, end, 39ᵇ חד בר נש נדר דלא מַרְוַוח (not מרווחא) a man made a vow that he would make no profit (in business). Ib. [read:] א״ל מאי אשבעת א״ל דלא מַרְוַוחְנָא he asked him, what didst thou swear (not to do)? Said he, that I will make no profit (v. Asheri to Gitt. 35ᵇ).

units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 73a:12">B. Mets. 73ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אנא נטרנא … ומרווחנא להו בכמה</he> I wait for them (give them time to move) until Iyar, and thus I benefit them greatly; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מַרְוַוח</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 56a">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ עסקך</he> thy business will be profitable, opp. <cite ref="Q01275"><he>פסיד</he></cite>.
